description: Reviewed third-party license policy for the locked Python environment. Any distribution that is not allowed, excepted, or listed by SPDX identifier fails the license gate. Exceptions match the exact observed metadata and expire so metadata fixes and license changes are rechecked.

click-default-group.reason: The distribution's bundled LICENSE contains BSD redistribution terms; its trove classifier is inaccurate. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

jinja2-ansible-filters.reason: Genuinely GPL-3.0-or-later. Accepted by the owner on 2026-11-16 as development-only tooling: Copier requires it unconditionally to render and test the starter, and shipped Python dependency closures must exclude it. test_gpl_generator_dependency_stays_development_only enforces that locked scope. Remove when copier-org/copier#2039 ships.

multidict.reason: The free-text License field and bundled LICENSE are Apache-2.0. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

protobuf.reason: The free-text License field and bundled LICENSE are BSD-3-Clause; required by the runtime telemetry OTLP exporter. Reviewed 2026-11-11.

pytest-timeout.reason: The License field and OSI classifier are MIT and the bundled LICENSE is MIT; the extra 'License :: DFSG approved' classifier has no SPDX mapping. Development-only test dependency. Reviewed 2026-11-14.

rich-click.reason: The distribution has no machine-readable license metadata; its bundled LICENSE is MIT. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

sqlite-fts4.reason: The free-text License field and bundled LICENSE are Apache-2.0. Reviewed 2026-10-22.

tiktoken.reason: The distribution's License field embeds full text and is unusable by the metadata-only guard; bundled licenses/LICENSE is MIT. Reviewed 2026-11-05.
